propositions: An implemented ticket must not close if its own plan or a pinned upstream plan changed during execution, without running plan review inside close.
A CLOSE validity profile disables code-freshness checks (HEAD and per-file dependency hashes) while keeping signature, reopen, registry, own-material, phase, and configured pin checks active.
The close plan-review gate runs only when require_plan_review_for_close is true for task/story/epic normal close, before completion verification, and performs no model or network calls.

A generic pre_status_check callback in transition_core runs inside the existing write lock immediately before STATUS append to re-validate on locked fresh state, catching races between precheck and lock.
Gate failures raise the exact verdict-prefixed error directing users to run rebar review-plan separately, and unexpected exceptions fail closed as verdict unavailable.
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea to closed) and force-close bypass are preserved, while structural child-closure rules are never bypassed.
